ea0a5158-5f0d-4631-9443-3a72df96287d.title: Satisfactory
ea0a5158-5f0d-4631-9443-3a72df96287d.summary: Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game with a dash of exploration and combat. Play alone or with friends, explore an alien planet, create multi-story factories, and enter conveyor belt heaven!

655a50de-7e0c-45ef-a885-0c0268ddd3df.title: EVE Online
655a50de-7e0c-45ef-a885-0c0268ddd3df.summary: EVE Online is a free-to-play community driven space MMO where players can choose their own path from countless different options. Experience space exploration, immense PvP and PvE battles, mining, industry and a thriving player economy in an ever-expanding sandbox.
